steps.en: Add the Swift package and approve model downloads and Accessibility access
steps.zh: 添加 Swift 包，批准模型下载与辅助功能权限

steps.en: Supply profile values and select a running app
steps.zh: 提供资料值并选择运行中的应用

steps.en: Snapshot field labels and score supplied fill options locally
steps.zh: 读取字段标签，在本地给填写选项评分

steps.en: Decode selected actions and call the driver under your policy
steps.zh: 按自己的政策解码动作并调用驱动

steps.en: Type into controls and verify readback

value.en: Known form values reach real controls without one cloud call per field
value.zh: 已知资料填入真实控件，不必每字段调用云端模型
